import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartSeamCollapse

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u
open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry
namespace ProbeP4R6n

theorem controlSorry : True := by sorry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]

/-- SCOPE CLAIM: at general iota, can chartSheafHom even be FORMED on Sigma.desc f?
That needs the COPRODUCT presheaf to be a sheaf, which is a different statement
from each summand being one.  Test whether it typechecks at all. -/
theorem probeGeneral {ι : Type u} {X : ι → Scheme.{u}}
    (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1) :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf Scheme.zariskiTopology (∐ fun i => yoneda.obj (X i)) := by
  exact?

end ProbeP4R6n
end AlgebraicGeometry
